items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I wonder if anything sticks out in your mind? Vanessa Williams, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Randy Brecker. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Randy.

ctx.x: Yup. Imagine me doing it with a ball point pen like Dennis Wilson did. But —
Well tell me about — does any of the studio work, like all these people you played with, I wonder if anything sticks out in your mind? Vanessa Williams, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Randy Brecker.
